title: GateDef
description:
A gate definition from JSON type `"gate"`.

Defines a gate or door that can be opened/closed via a control mechanism.

bashing_damage.description: Bashing damage dealt by the gate.

copy_from.description: Base definition id to copy fields from.

door.description: The door terrain placed when the gate is closed.

floor.description: The floor terrain placed when the gate is open.

messages.description: Messages displayed when interacting with the gate.

moves.description: Movement cost to operate the gate.

walls.description: List of wall terrains that this gate is compatible with. An empty list matches any wall.
